_template_note: NON-AUTHORIZING TEMPLATE. The owner fills every <field> and installs the result HIMSELF at <state_root>/m4_confirmation_authority/OWNER_M4_CONFIRMATION_EXECUTION_RECORD.json, AFTER Musashi's design-review record exists (this record must chain to it by digest). Candidate code never creates or installs a real record; the extra key (_template_note) and placeholders are both refused by the consuming API.
author: <owner-signature-name>
authorized_review_record_sha256: <64-hex record_sha256 of Musashi's installed design-review record>
authorized_population_statement: <one sentence naming the 21 eligible slots, 48 generators per slot, 3 nested seeds (3024 units)>
cpu_limits_statement: <one sentence naming the sealed CPU wall, RSS, nice, heartbeat and stop-file limits that govern the run>
record_sha256: <64-hex sha256 of the canonical body excluding this field>
